answer: In an AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism employs a glacier-like approach to verify identities. An anchor node, chosen for its stability and reputation, is designated as the primary identifier. New agents must participate in a voyage of reputation-building by providing valuable contributions, gradually earning the trust of the anchor node and the community. As a fake agent attempts to infiltrate the network, its lack of contributions will be exposed, rendering its identity vulnerable to rejection, thus protecting the economy from Sybil attacks.
